title: Beer-Braised Oysters
description: A hearty German-style oyster dish featuring a rich beer-braised sauce.

ingredients.name: mexican
ingredients.amount: 1-2 dried ancho chilies, stemmed and seeded

instructions: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sliced onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until caramelized (10-12 minutes).
Add ancho chilies and cook for 1 minute.
Add beer and bring to a boil, scraping up browned bits.
Add oysters and cook until they start to open (3-4 minutes).
Transfer skillet to preheated oven and bake at 400°F for 5-7 minutes, or until oysters are cooked through.
Remove skillet from oven and stir in nectarous, heavy cream, and pulled tamales.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
